title: Choose between two values
summary: Spring Framework: Choose between two values. Ask for red instead.
introduction: A container can hold several beans of one type. A name selects the one you need.
learningObjectives: Choose between two values with Spring Framework

blocks.text: Install Java 17 or later and JBang. Save each example as Lesson.java and run jbang Lesson.java. The //DEPS line lets JBang fetch Spring. These examples use the core container and do not start a web server.

blocks.title: Choose between two values

blocks.text: Both beans have type String. The explicit name blue selects one unambiguously.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A lookup by type alone is ambiguous when two beans match.
